The 50 Percent Rule: entities owned 50 percent or more, individually or in the aggregate, by blocked persons are themselves blocked even if not on the SDN list
Blocked property and rejected transactions are reported to OFAC within 10 business days under 31 CFR 501.603
Holders of blocked property file an annual report by September 30 covering June 30 holdings under 31 CFR 501.604
OFAC maintains the SDN list and its non-SDN supplements
The UK maintains the OFSI consolidated list for UK-connected activity
